data.name: Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats - Hidden Objects Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats – a cozy hidden object game for cat lovers! 🐾

Relax and unwind as you explore 30 breathtaking gardens filled with hidden cats 🐱, charming treasures, and peaceful atmospheres. This delightful sequel combines the joy of seek and find puzzles with the soothing beauty of nature, creating the perfect escape for fans of cozy hidden object games.

🌸 Explore a World of Cozy Gardens

  • Globetrotting Gardens 🌍 – Travel across 120 stunning locations, from tranquil Japanese Zen gardens to colorful Mediterranean villas. Each scene is crafted with love and cozy details.

  • Feline Friends 🐈 – Search high and low to find hidden items, playful kittens and cuddly cats cleverly hidden in every scene.

  • Hidden Treasures ✨ – Discover antique vases, rare butterflies, sparkling jewels, and whimsical surprises scattered across peaceful gardens.

🎶 Relax and Unwind

  • Soothing Soundscapes 🎼 – Immerse yourself in beautiful background music and relaxing sounds that turn every level into a peaceful escape.

  • Play Your Way 🎮 – Choose between timed challenges or relaxing modes with unlimited hints. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, this game adapts to your style.

🐾 Why You’ll Love It

Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats isn’t just a game – it’s a cozy escape. Perfect for cat lovers, hidden object fans, and anyone seeking a relaxing way to unwind. With hundreds of levels, collectible postcards, and bonus mini-games, there’s always something new to discover.

✨ Key Features

  • Over 200 levels of hidden object fun

  • 120 cozy garden scenes full of cats & treasures

  • Classic seek and find gameplay with modern polish

  • 5 bonus puzzle games: Hidden Cats, Hidden Shapes, Seek & Find, Word Search, Find Numbers, Word Ninja

  • Collect postcards, treasures, and visit the Pet Shop

🎁 Collector’s Edition Bonus

  • 46 exclusive levels in Trip to Thailand hidden object journey

  • 90 bonus Spot the Difference puzzles

  • 67 cozy wallpapers for your desktop

  • 3 extra mini-games: Match Pairs, Find Objects, Zombie Attack

🌿🐱 Peaceful Gardens 2: Cute Cats – a cozy hidden object journey for cat lovers. Relax, explore, and let the magic of cute cats brighten your day.
